independentReview.scope: Independent rerun of the same 10 author DOM tests plus one added held-key/selected-purpose check; not 11 additional distinct cases. The added check preserves pending intent/feedback after Enter/pointer on selected purpose, then changes purpose with one Space keydown, three repeat keydowns and keyup without new export; late feedback stays rejected.

coverage.result: Actual existing viewport wrapper controls and measured outputs confirmed 1440,1024,390,320 by 900 CSS px. Not device-emulated touch/mobile OS testing. Export error layout visually checked at all four widths.

1440 task input named 搜尋已載入事項 before entry, after 圖畫書 entry, and after 清除搜尋. Care input named 搜尋已保存記錄 before/after 圖畫書 entry and search submission. Tab from care input moved to 種類：全部; Enter submitted search. 1024 care screenshot confirms visible field and result.

1024 opened synthetic preparation A by Enter; recovery UI armed 下一次文件寫入延遲; Space on 合成清單：準備水樽 produced pending save. Real browser :focus remained DIV role=checkbox aria-disabled=true aria-checked=false with same label and visible focus outline. No simulated DOM test substituted.

During held save, Enter on 成長與關注 link opened 先處理原操作 dialog. Enter on 留在此頁查核 dismissed it without navigation, preserved preparation, and restored focus to 成長與關注 link. Recovery UI 釋放最早等待 settled synthetic write and later checkbox showed checked, 1/2 count. At390 Space checked second item; 2/2 shown. Immediate navigation remained guarded until settling, then worked.

390 and320 keyboard Enter submission, and1440 pointer retry, were blocked by original synthetic adapter. Error visibly appeared inside same open modal: PDF 未能取得，沒有改用其他版本。請重新讀取並核對來源後再試。 Feedback had role=alert and actual focus at data-testid=growth-export-feedback. All four widths showed readable feedback plus close and retry actions.

Tab from feedback moved to 關閉. Enter close and Escape dismiss removed modal and restored focus to 導出報告. Reopening cleared previous feedback. Explicit retry produced same expected adapter error without fabricated success. Enter selection of 照護交接版 changed aria-checked and cleared feedback.

320 closed prior export modal, selected 合成小晴 via child picker using Enter; growth reset to concerns, reopened archive and export. New modal period belonged to 合成小晴, old feedback was empty, default purpose reset. New attempt produced own expected adapter error. This is settled-error child switching, not pending late-response race.

Browser DOM read confirmed html computed zoom=1.4 at1440 and1.2 at320, respective scrollWidth/clientWidth equal 1440/1440 and320/320. No outer horizontal page overflow at these endpoints. Visually checked modal containment at all four widths.

Deployed page scripts included original qa-fixture.js, qa-recovery-fixture.js and exact candidate bundle filename. Browser-read CSP retains connect-src none; other network isolation established separately by independent static/VM checks. No fixture edits, model calls, real family inputs, permission changes or publication by reviewer.
